Raidho — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᚱ
journey progress good timing on the right track

Upright meaning

Raidho is your 'you're on the right path' rune. Whether you're literally travelling or working through something longer-term, this rune says the journey is going well and you're moving in the right direction.

Things are flowing. You're in sync with what needs to happen. If a trip is coming up, it's well-starred. If you're in the middle of a big project or life change, trust that you're progressing at the right pace.

Raidho is also about doing things in the right order — not rushing, not dragging your feet. There's a natural timing to how things unfold, and right now you're working with it rather than against it.

Reversed meaning

Reversed Raidho is a signal that something in your journey is off. Maybe there's a delay you weren't expecting, or you're suddenly not sure you're heading in the right direction.

Travel plans might hit snags. A long-term project might feel like it's going in circles.

The honest question to ask yourself is: am I actually heading where I want to go? Sometimes what looks like a setback is actually an invitation to course-correct before you get too far down the wrong road.
